test_sample_embedding: test the SampleEmbeddingModule by running parametrized tests with varying sample sizes and dataset splits
run_SampleEmbeddingModule: run the SampleEmbeddingModule to sample and concatenate embedding shards into a single output file
create_SampleEmbeddingModuleConfig: create a SampleEmbeddingModuleConfig with language, embedded files list, data config, output dir, and sample size
review_SampleEmbeddingModule_run: review the SampleEmbeddingModule run method that parallel-samples embeddings across shards using joblib
refactor__sample_single: refactor the _sample_single function to handle edge cases where shard size is smaller than sample size
